scoring_justification: Pearson correlation and linear regression recomputed from submitted per-boundary scalars; no hidden gold table needed.

hidden_assets.purpose: correlation threshold and slope/intercept ranges derived from paper results
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Fig.3 and text describing near-perfect linear collapse of ΔV vs (1-ρ^GB); Fig.6 and text describing near-unity slope and small intercept for S_ρ^GB vs ½ S_sum^GB
hidden_assets.generation_method: derived from paper descriptions; r_threshold set to 0.98 (near-perfect linear); slope interval [0.95,1.05] around unity; intercept bound |b| ≤ 0.005
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: thresholds reflect the paper's reported tight linear relationships; they are the reproducibility target

outputs.description: Per-grain-boundary scalar properties: density deficit, coordination deficit, excess free volume, GB energy, and configurational entropies. The checker computes Pearson correlation between delta_V and rho_deficit, and linear regression between S_rho and S_sum_half, comparing against hidden thresholds.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker performs T1 recompute: it reads gb_properties.csv, computes the Pearson correlation r between delta_V and rho_deficit, and the slope/intercept of S_rho vs. S_sum_half, then scores against hidden gold values derived from the paper.

steps.description: Verify CSV structure: 408 rows, required columns present.
Compute Pearson correlation between delta_V and rho_deficit; score against hidden threshold.
Fit linear regression S_rho vs S_sum_half; check slope in [0.95,1.05] and |intercept| <= 0.005.
